## Overview

The BES870 is a versatile espresso machine that allows users to grind, dose, and extract their coffee all in one machine. It is designed to elevate the coffee experience and provide a high-quality, consistent cup of espresso.
## Key Features
- Grind and dose coffee beans
- Removable reservoir for easy cleaning
- 19-bar pump for perfect espresso and lungo
- Compact design
- Brew up to 20 café-quality drinks
- Hot and cold recipes, including espresso, latte, cappuccino, and more
- 4 user profiles for customized drinks
- Cappuccino in cup system
- Color display and buttons for easy navigation
- Professional aroma grinder for consistent grinding result
- Sophisticated operating concept
- Timeless, elegant design
## How it Works

The BES870 espresso machine works by grinding the coffee beans and dosing them into the brew basket, which doubles as a scoop. The pump then pushes water through the grounds at 19 bars, extracting the espresso and lungo. The removable reservoir can be cleaned easily, and the compact design makes it suitable for small kitchens. The machine can make up to 20 café-quality drinks, and users can choose from a variety of hot and cold recipes, including espresso, latte, cappuccino, and more. The machine also has 4 user profiles, allowing users to customize their drinks according to their preferences. The Cappuccino in Cup system delivers coffee specialties with impeccable results.
## Benefits
- Elevates the coffee experience
- Provides consistent, high-quality espresso
- Allows for customization of drinks
- Compact and elegant design
- Easy to use and clean
- Suitable for small kitchens
- Multiple drink options
- Professional aroma grinder
## Conclusion

The BES870 espresso machine is a versatile, high-quality coffee maker that allows users to grind, dose, and extract their coffee all in one machine. It is designed to elevate the coffee experience and provide a consistent, high-quality cup of espresso. With its compact design, multiple drink options, and customizable profiles, it is a great choice for coffee lovers looking for a professional-grade espresso machine.",19
